driver_assessment.conclusion: Both fixed-field conditional posteriors now pass unchanged convergence gates and include the true curvature. Z9's displaced curvature occurs when jointly inferring the fields under its approximate z=0 prior; the conditional observation fit on these two mocks does not reproduce that displacement.
driver_assessment.not_established: This does not isolate the field prior alone, validate an independent galaxy-formation/selection model, prove calibration from two intervals, or establish real CF4 density recovery. The observation generator and fitted link share code. No LG-resolution or IC milestone was achieved.
driver_assessment.next_focus: Field-prior/observation coupling and physical density statistics; do not add further tracer flexibility based on Z8's withdrawn interpretation. Specify a bounded prior-compatible versus PM-truth comparison before further fits.
